question: The second edition of Khelo India Youth Games, 2019 was organised in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pune**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second edition of **Khelo India Youth Games, 2019** was organized in **Pune**.
 
• Pune is known for its vibrant sports culture and has hosted numerous national and international sporting events.
 
• The event saw participation from thousands of young athletes across the country, competing in various sports disciplines.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an initiative by the Government of India to encourage sports at the grassroots level and identify young talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** was launched in 2018 as part of the Khelo India programme, aiming to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• The first edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in **New Delhi** in 2018.
 
• The event includes various sports such as athletics, badminton, basketball, football, gymnastics, hockey, judo, kabaddi, swimming, volleyball, weightlifting, and wrestling, among others.
 
• The Khelo India programme also provides scholarships to young athletes to support their training and development.
 
• The initiative is part of the broader vision to make India a sporting superpower by enhancing sports infrastructure and nurturing young talent.
